stem.en: Which statement about a lung is correct?

text.en: A lung is one very large cell that holds air.

feedback.en: A lung is made of a huge number of cells.

text.en: A lung is a tissue, because all of its cells are the same.

feedback.en: A tissue is a group of similar cells. A lung holds several different tissues.

text.en: A lung is a complete organ system, because breathing needs nothing else.

feedback.en: An organ system is several organs working together. The lung is one of them.

text.en: A lung is an organ made of tissues, and tissues are made of cells.

explanation.en:
**Why "an organ made of tissues" is right**

Similar cells form tissues, different tissues form an organ, and several organs form an organ system. The lung is one organ in the respiratory system.

**Why the others are not**

- **One large cell** - this mixes up the smallest level and a much larger one.
- **A tissue** - a lung has several different tissues.
- **An organ system** - the system also includes the nasal pores, nasal cavity and trachea.

hints.en: Put the four levels in order, from smallest to largest.
How many different tissues does a lung hold?
